reason: Only the SMS-lock half of the claim holds: scheduleSMS returns undefined when isLockedForSMSSending (twilioProvider.ts:90-95), the new else-branch increments retryCount (scheduleSMSReminders.ts:178-186), and the new `retryCount > 1` clause in deleteMany deletes the reminder after two failed runs, where before it stayed queued until scheduledDate. The rate-limit half is wrong: checkSMSRateLimit does not throw (checkRateLimitAndThrowError.ts:29-46), it only sets the lock state to REVIEW_NEEDED for smsMonth, so rate-limited users still get their SMS scheduled and are not counted as failures.
